dataset: SagarNetra-SSS-IN v1 (Real Seabed + Hybrid Test Split)

stages.notes: Struggles with shadowless flat nets; confuses natural rock ridges and sand ripples with marine debris.

stages.configuration: + 3-Channel Sonar Feature Stack (Intensity, Shadow CFAR, Sato Ridge)
stages.notes: Sato filter dramatically enhances twine and rope edge visibility; shadow probability separates proud targets from seabed textures.

stages.configuration: + Dedicated Net Signature Head (LoG Floats, MST Chain, Mesh Gabor)
stages.notes: Captures periodic float/sinker chains along headrope even when the net panel is 50% buried or flat.

stages.evaluation_source: HYBRID + REAL (tested on real wreck benchmarks and hybrid nets)
stages.notes: Massive 61% reduction in false alarms: rejects water-column multipath, nadir crosstalk, and unphysical shadow orders.

stages.evaluation_source: REAL (coreset trained purely on real clean seafloor from KLSG-II & NOAA)
stages.notes: Flags out-of-distribution debris (submerged containers, twisted cyclone wreckage) lacking predefined classes.

stages.configuration: + Hazard Confidence Fusion & Temperature Calibration (Full SagarNetra)
stages.evaluation_source: REAL + HYBRID (calibrated on real wreck validation split & hybrid split)
stages.notes: Well-calibrated probabilities. Dive teams receive honest confidence metrics with full component breakdown.

conclusion: Progressive ablation confirms that physics grounding, multi-feature sonification, and the specialized Net Signature Head are essential to overcoming the severe acoustic limitations of standard vision backbones.
